items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you sir, it’s so nice to see you.

ctx.x: That’s very interesting ‘cause I just listened to it this morning because I knew that was part of your story. And when I was listening to it —
How do you learn these things, Monk?
But I was listening to it thinking of how that was for you and I can imagine it was a challenge.
